notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 2023
notes.notes:
Hi Lacrosse Fans!

An update has been pushed that corrects an issue that prevented the game from launching. 

Thanks for all your support over the years in enjoying this game!

notes.title: New Update for Casey powell Lacrosse 16
notes.notes:
We've been hard at work bringing improvements and gameplay tweaks for Casey Powell Lacrosse 16 and today the updates have been released for Steam.

Below are the change notes for the update:

TUNING
Tuned sprint ability to sprint when button is pressed.
Tuned defensive pressure.
Tuned AI transition speed.
Tuned input selection after ball collect.
Tuned faceoff time length.
Tuned online player selection.
Tuned check spamming exploits.
Tuned intercept distance.

ADDITIONS
Added free roam mode to main menu.

FIXES
Stability improvements.
Corrected lineup selection in casual mode.

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards!
notes.notes:
As a day one special announcement, we have just released Steam Trading Cards with Casey Powell Lacrosse 16!

For those that don't know what Steam Trading Cards are, they're a fun initiative that will drop collectible cards for you per a set amount of game time you play on Casey Powell Lacrosse 16.

As you collect these cards you will be able to fill out your collection and eventually craft badges, profile backgrounds and emoticons to display on your profile and show off to your friends!

Have fun and enjoy!
